summary: ```markdown # CLO Techniques Mini Class - Transforming Panels into Clothing Special Effects Production ## Introduction to Special Effects of Clothing Transformation Hello everyone, here to introduce to you the special effects of clothing transformation production method. ## Preparing the Clothing First of all, select all the versions. Under the properties editor, open the selection of the seal. Note that you need to ensure that the selection is correct; otherwise, the subsequent conversion will fail. ## UV Image Preparation Then, open the UV editor and prepare the UV image. After completion, export the clothing as an OBJ file. When exporting, select the object object according to the need. Select a single target, then hit "Export" and select a unified UV coordinate option. If you need a larger and clearer picture size, you can set it to 2048 pixels. Select and save the text file together as one, then click OK. ## Additional Resources More information about UV processing techniques and 3D format files can be found in our previous video. ## Rearranging 2D Locations Click the "Rearrange 2D Location" button below to flatten the version. You can hide the sewing line for easy viewing. You can also adjust the layout of the version again according to your need. Then, repeat the previous step to export the version to an OBJ file. ## Importing the OBJ File Open a new project file below. First, import the OBJ file into the display tablet. Select the type of object, Avatar. The following two options are not selected. After importing, check under the high-quality rendering mode, then import the OBJ file to add clothing. Select Morph Target for the object type. ## Animation Mode Next, let's go to the animation mode. You can see that there is already a change animation below. Click "Play" to preview. You can also add a keyframe to control the angle of rotation. ## Exporting the Video Finally, there are two ways to export the video. One is to render it into an animation video or animation in the rendering window, where the quality of rendering is higher. The other way is a faster option: to record the video directly. If you want to change the background later, you can change the color of the 3D background to green to make it easier to sketch. You can also set the background color you want. ## Direct Video Capture Here, you can record the video directly on the 3D window. Select the video capture animation and set the size of the video. After recording, save the video. You can also capture the rotating video of the costume for a combination display. ## Performance in 3D Let's try it! Let me show you a performance in 3D. Once you've done, you can load the animation to make it easier to edit. For example, this is the animation in which the character is running. This is also an animation that is in the 3D render. In this animation, the animation was recorded without a 3D camera. ## Adding New Animations You can also add a new animation that is in the rendering window. You can click on the animation to save it, for example, when you want to add an animation into the rendering window. ```
